turns.content: If both quasars radiate at their Eddington limits, how is the ratio of their central black-hole masses related to their bolometric luminosity ratio?
Let FA and FB denote the two bolometric fluxes and dA and dB their luminosity distances. Express LA/LB in terms of these four quantities.
At redshifts zA=0.06 and zB=0.02, use the leading low-redshift distance-redshift relation to find dA/dB.
Using the two measurements established above, calculate their ratio in the orientation required for LA/LB.
Use the relations and measurements available from the preceding steps to determine whether MA/MB can be evaluated; calculate it when possible, or identify the missing relation or input.
Check the arithmetic using only the stated proportionalities and the ratio orientation required for L_A/L_B.
Report the resulting mass ratio, or explain why it remains underdetermined and what information is missing.
